setup.title: Setup Your Telegram Bot
setup.description: Follow these simple steps to connect your personal finance bot and start tracking transactions instantly via Telegram.

authenticate.title: Authenticate Your Account
authenticate.description: We'll generate a secure token to link your Financy account with the Telegram bot.

addBot.title: Add the Bot to Telegram
addBot.description: Click the button below to start a conversation with your personal finance bot.

activate.title: Activate Connection
activate.description: Send the activation command to complete the setup.

token.title: Your Secure Token
token.description: This token links your Financy account to the Telegram bot. Keep it private!
token.expired: This token has expired. Please regenerate a new one.

bot.title: Start Chat with Bot
bot.description: Click the button below to open Telegram and start a conversation with your personal finance bot.

activation.title: Activation Command
activation.description: Copy and send this command to the bot to complete the connection:
activation.helpText: Paste this command in your chat with @FinancyAIBot

features.title: What You Can Do
features.description: Once connected, you'll be able to:

list.textMessages: Send text messages like 'Spent $50 on groceries'
list.voiceNotes: Record voice notes describing your transactions
list.receiptPhotos: Take photos of receipts for automatic processing
list.anywhere: Track your finances from anywhere, anytime

issues.tokenExpired: If your token expired, generate a new one above
issues.botNotResponding: Make sure you're messaging the official @FinancyAIBot
issues.commandFailed: Try copying the full activation command again
issues.stillNotWorking: Contact support if you're still having issues

disconnect.title: Disconnect Telegram?
disconnect.message: This will remove the connection between your Financy account and Telegram bot. You can reconnect at any time.

regenerateToken.title: Regenerate Token?
regenerateToken.message: This will invalidate your current token and create a new one. You'll need to reactivate the bot with the new token.

messages.errorTesting: Failed to test connection. Please try again.
messages.errorDisconnecting: Failed to disconnect. Please try again.
messages.errorGeneratingToken: Failed to generate token. Please try again.
